title: SQLite with auto-migration over managed DB
rationale: No infrastructure required. Schema migrates via _migrate_schema() in db.py which uses PRAGMA table_info to detect missing columns and runs ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN. Always add new columns to the migrations dict - never delete fees.db manually. WAL mode enabled.

title: CBOE CSV content_type threads through pipeline
rationale: FetchResult.content_type is set to 'csv' by CboeFetcher. pipeline.py reads this to set content_type='csv' passed to extractor.extract(). ClaudeExtractor passes it to build_user_message() which uses a different prompt preamble for CSV vs PDF/HTML inputs. MockExtractor also accepts the param but ignores it.
